description: Get a link to download one of the user's CVs (resumes) as PDF or Word (DOCX), valid 10 minutes. Needs a one-time purchase for that CV or PRO (Europass template: PRO); otherwise it returns the reason and links instead of a file. Opening the link counts as one PRO download (once per link); a CV bought once downloads without limit. Use when the user wants the file.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: get_takemeup_download_link
title: Download my CV (PDF / Word)
